comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Round Seal Map comes from St. Petersburg. You'll need Far North language (sold in town from Daikokuya for 1m ducats) or Nordic language (Germanic translation notes sold in London, Amsterdam, and Stockholm give Nordic) to read books in that town, though.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I'm puzzled by this as well. There might be a required discovery or two which the Asian wikis simply haven't noted; sadly, we can't check for sure since archive maps don't seem to have a "past steps/requirements" process like actual quests. Obviously you'd need port permit access to the White Sea, but a player like yourself wouldn't have that issue to deal with. Hmm...

Other than comparing your bio and/or geo discoveries with pempem and seeing if there's any differences, I can't think of any other way to try and unravel the mystery, at least at this time. Hope someday the answer can be known. Thanks for alerting us a problem existed; could save others quite a few headaches (meds and otherwise) in the future.
